req.title: Pagination via skip and limit
req.statement: The system shall skip the first 'skip' items and cap the returned count at 'limit' when both are supplied to GET /tasks/.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /tasks/?skip=<s>&limit=<l> skips the first s items and returns at most l items. With 20 pre-loaded rows we can verify: (1) positive EP — typical skip+limit returns exactly limit items and the correct slice; (2) boundary BVA — skip=0,limit=1 returns exactly 1 item (the first); skip=19,limit=1 returns exactly 1 item (the last); skip=20,limit=1 returns 0 items (past end); limit at its declared minimum (ge=1) and maximum (le=1000); (3) negative NEG — skip<0 and limit<1 and limit>1000 each return HTTP 422. Tests assert exact counts and exact item ids to kill off-by-one, operator-flip, and constant-bump mutations.

tests.name: test_skip_and_limit_typical_slice
preconditions: Database contains exactly 20 pre-loaded tasks with ids 1-20
expected: HTTP 200
Response body is a list of exactly 3 items
The ids of the returned items are the 6th, 7th, and 8th tasks in default DB order (ids 6, 7, 8)
trace: R-TASK-005: skip=5 skips first 5 rows; limit=3 caps at 3 rows
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_skip_and_limit_typical_slice():
    r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=5&limit=3")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert isinstance(data, list)
    assert len(data) == 3
    ids = [item["id"] for item in data]
    assert ids[0] == 6
    assert ids[1] == 7
    assert ids[2] == 8

tests.name: test_skip_one_reduces_count_by_one
preconditions: Database contains exactly 20 pre-loaded tasks with ids 1-20
actions: GET /tasks/?skip=1&limit=20 to verify skip=1 removes exactly one item
expected: Baseline returns 20 items
skip=1 returns 19 items
First item of skip=1 response has id=2 (id=1 was skipped)
trace: R-TASK-005: skip=1 boundary — exactly one item removed from front; catches off-by-one mutation on offset
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_skip_one_reduces_count_by_one():
    r0 = client.get("/tasks/?skip=0&limit=20")
    assert r0.status_code == 200
    baseline = r0.json()
    assert len(baseline) == 20

    r1 = client.get("/tasks/?skip=1&limit=20")
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    data = r1.json()
    assert len(data) == 19
    assert data[0]["id"] == 2

tests.name: test_response_fields_present_and_typed
preconditions: Database contains exactly 20 pre-loaded tasks with ids 1-20
expected: HTTP 200
Each item contains id, title, description, completed, created_at fields
id is an integer, completed is a boolean, title is a non-empty string
trace: R-TASK-005: verifies payload schema for a typical paginated slice — catches mutations that drop or mistype fields
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_response_fields_present_and_typed():
    r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=2&limit=2")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert len(data) == 2
    item = data[0]
    assert isinstance(item["id"], int)
    assert isinstance(item["title"], str)
    assert len(item["title"]) > 0
    assert isinstance(item["completed"], bool)
    assert "created_at" in item
    assert item["id"] == 3
    assert item["title"] == "Submit expense report"
    assert item["completed"] is True
